artifact_review:
The Router flagged minor texture anomalies on the nose and slight edge bleeding on the ear (Severity 1.0-1.5). The Perceptual Quality Auditor found no global distortions (Score 0.0). However, the Animal Pose Auditor reported a HIGH artifact risk (71% low-confidence keypoints). 

Crucially, I must interpret this pose data carefully. The high-confidence keypoints are located on the eyes and nose (the focal point of the image), while the low-confidence keypoints are on the shoulders, limbs, and hindquarters which are either out of focus, cropped, or obscured by fur. In AI-generated close-ups, it is common for the generator to prioritize facial fidelity while letting peripheral anatomy degrade or become ambiguous. Since the visible facial structure (confirmed by high-confidence pose points) is anatomically sound, and the topology mask is clean (0.98 confidence), the 'HIGH' pose risk is likely a false positive driven by the crop/occlusion rather than catastrophic structural failure. The minor edge bleeding noted by the Router is the most significant actual artifact, but it is subtle. Therefore, I will not penalize the artifact score as severely as the pose auditor's raw data might suggest, but I will keep it below perfect due to the nose texture smudge and ear edge softness.
